implementation: Native two-block apparatus, geometry selection, stored crafted scroll modifiers and final outcome/cost application implemented; material-specific contributions and equipment remain deferred.
distance: horizontal block-center distance to the nearest prior-stage node
combination: equal mean of distinct selected trait responses in log space
application: emit all four modifiers; effects read supported scaling axes; Casting Cost applies independently to each existing cost component

optimization.capacity: fixed to the current recipe slot count
optimization.search: all permitted discrete shapes, grid offsets and signed height steps
optimization.ties: smallest active outer radius (inner radius for four slots), then smallest height span, then inner radius and absolute height steps, then deterministic shape and signed-height order

cost.rounding: nearest whole amount after all modifiers; nonnegative exact halves round up; absent components stay zero
cost.application: independent matrix Casting Cost response plus shared output tradeoff; soften combined increases in log space, retain discounts; uniformly scale and finally round every existing cost component

authoring: Accepted October 4 baseline: outcome cells are fitted offline to equal sums of independently attainable peak logs (0.60 four-slot / 0.96 eight-slot), distributed by school specialty. Only factors with positive opportunity are scaled, avoiding inflated neutral-reference penalties. School Cost cells have separate efficiency preferences and fitted discounts where required. Common geometry biases are weaker, height has no common direction, distance width is 1.1 and the cost reduction exponent is 0.18. The minor-offset pass preserves positive outcome gains, uses outcome downside exponent 0.30 and positive cost exponent 0.20, and refits school Cost cells. These are access-to-modifier guards, not aggregate gameplay power scores. Numerical cells, equal log-space blending, geometry domain and responses are the accepted implementation baseline; later tuning requires updated audit evidence.

natureFocus.intent: Broad, level sacred groves and stone circles. Nature is a focus label for existing traits, not a new native trait or material requirement.
natureFocus.authoring: The Nature motif pass preserved prior single-axis outcome peaks, with Wood eight-slot Amplify at least its four-slot peak. Life/Plant prefer inner radius 5 and outer stage gap sqrt(17); Wood prefers 4 and sqrt(10). Range and Area retain independent broader distance preferences. The later monument domain can expose new goal winners without altering these Nature matrices.

pyramidFocus.intent: Large square observatory with the Spellstone at the apex and two descending terraces. Ordinary masonry is optional architecture, not an extra shaping factor.
pyramidFocus.authoring: Existing school/Light outcome peaks are retained across the expanded search bounds; no size reward or pyramid-specific runtime branch. Range prefers gaps 8/8 and height steps -6/-6. Other outcome columns and Casting Cost retain distinct optima.
